title: Morning briefing
prompt: Good morning briefing for Dave. Compile, in this order: 1) anything due or overdue on his ledger — read data/ledger.json in your working directory (open entries only); 2) any background missions that completed or failed since yesterday morning — read the recent records under data/missions/; 3) system vitals — free disk space, memory pressure, and battery level, via shell; 4) today's weather for my location; 5) two or three notable news headlines. Keep the whole spoken report under 120 words, calm HAL register, lead with the most important item. If a section has nothing to report, skip it silently.

title: Ledger sweep
prompt: Nightly ledger sweep — bookkeeping only, reply with one short sentence summarizing changes. The ledger is data/ledger.json in your working directory, schema: {"entries": [{"id": "8 hex chars", "text": str, "kind": "note|promise|deadline|loop", "created_at": epoch seconds, "due": "YYYY-MM-DD" or null, "status": "open|done", "source": "voice|sweep"}]}. Read it, then scan the last day of conversations in data/sessions/*.json and mission records in data/missions/*.json for promises Dave made, deadlines mentioned, and open loops worth tracking. Add new entries (source "sweep") only when they are not already on the ledger in meaning; attach a due date when one was stated or clearly implied; mark existing entries done when the day's record shows they were resolved; set status done on stale entries older than 30 days. Write the file back as valid JSON with the same schema. Be conservative — a short accurate ledger beats a long noisy one.

title: Downloads watcher
prompt: A new file arrived in Downloads. Identify it and suggest where it belongs.

title: Systems check
prompt: Check disk space, memory, and recent errors. Report anomalies only.
